author: Codex primary release agent
reviewer: CodeRabbit AI editorial review for PR #129

userValue.rationale: The notes identify users of coordinated tasks with a planning worker and describe the observable result: the task continues after the planner launches instead of stopping.

plainLanguage.rationale: The revised notes lead with the visible task behavior and use the reviewer-proposed launch-ID wording. Internal terms called out in the first review, including action identity, receipt.actionId, and coordinator, were removed.

publicMigration.rationale: The fix removes no public capability and requires no separate migration procedure. The entry states the recovery behavior for a missing action ID without sending users to private or unavailable guidance.

accurateClaims.rationale: The revised text states the two behaviors supported by the diff: installed instructions identify the launch ID to copy, and receipt validation reports the exact correction when that ID is omitted. It no longer claims automatic preservation.

scopeSeparation.rationale: The notes contain only the user-visible failure and corrected behavior. They omit CI details, test counts, hashes, review metadata, and implementation inventories.
